fightguy.status: Approved direction 2026-10-03; icons installed and Training HUD verified; VFX unchanged
fightguy.grammar: Physical strikes first, ki amplifying them. Compressed, directional, punchy energy; dense rounded projectile head with a short swept-back tail, compact limb arcs, brief pressure bursts or flattened impact rings.
fightguy.constraints: Keep blue visible. Small hot cores; no ice, frost, crystalline shards, lingering clouds or lightning branches. Flat icons use kiBlue; glow belongs to VFX. Global UI, HUD category frames and damage colors remain unchanged.

specials.E: Rising Dragon / rise: blue-white fist accent leads ascent; tapered upward streak trails below the fist along actual motion. Optional subordinate takeoff accent. Compact burst on contact only; no lifting beam or full-body glow.
specials.R: Cyclone Kick / rotate: two or three broken ki ribbons circle lower torso and kicking leg; strongest streak follows kicking foot. Readable gaps, compact vortex traveling with fighter, clearing when spin ends. No solid tornado cone or lingering cloud.
specials.F: Fist of Fury / strike: alternating short energy wraps and dense trails on six punches; compact bursts on actual connections only. Heavier right-foot finisher accent and one decisive contact burst. No surrounding aura or long ribbons.

fightguy.iconSubjects: Uppercut, rotating kick, empowered strike; distinct silhouettes rather than glow.

assetTrials.status: Agreed starting points 2026-10-03; not implemented or preview-verified. Placement, scale and timing first; no blanket recolor upfront.
assetTrials.Q: Keep current projectile unchanged; add CFXR4 Plasma Shoot (Blue) at the hands along shot direction once when release animation starts, not during aim or on the traveling projectile.
assetTrials.F: Trial CFXR3 Hit Ice A (Air) on actual contacts: smaller repeated punch bursts, stronger final-kick burst. No contact bursts on misses. Keep existing look initially; reduce obscuring layers only if necessary.
assetTrials.R: Trial CFXR4 Sword Trail ICE (180 Thin Spiral) around kicking-leg region, aligned to spin with readable gaps; clear when spin ends. No custom tornado unless this proves insufficient.
assetTrials.E: Fist-led upward trail accepted; source effect unselected.

fightguy.iconReview: Workspace _bmad-output/fightguy-ability-icons/specials-review/: revised circular-kick R and multistrike F accepted as good enough; accepted PNGs installed in Resources/Icons/FightGuy.

bonk.grammar: Weight, metal and physical impact. Broad short blade sweeps, dust and chipped-metal fragments rather than orange energy trails.
bonk.constraints: Flat icons use warm steel, not dark iron. Existing orange model accents may remain small details without becoming Bonk's identity. Global UI, HUD category frames and damage-tier colors remain unchanged.

narrative.northStar: Low-poly underground toy-fight-club, with DIY internet-game energy
narrative.overview: Scavenged low-poly fight-club forms and curated asset-pack collage. Cool first, joke second; slightly crappy on purpose, extremely readable. Frontend pages are paper-led using the user-authored FrontendPaperBackground.png, continuing behind the transparent top bar with readable control-local paper backing and ink borders. Separate ink foreground/dark-field roles remain. Home has left modes, a larger aspect-fitted framed poster at center, and right announcements. Chat is an absolute user-sized bottom-left overlay with paper frame/tabs and grouped Hide/Resize, no maximize; dimensions never rebalance underlying layout. Fighter/stage participants and Player/CPU controls sit bottom middle/right, leaving bottom-left clear by default. Settings uses paper outer framing/categories and calm dark utility fields. Gameplay HUD uses larger 330×120 portrait-led fight cards with explicit lives, one adjacent KO/OUT stock-loss stamp, four paired move keys (Paper normal tabs on orange plates over raised Ink special keys on blue plates) exposing all eight moves in 1/A–2/R–3/E–4/F order, hover names, an effective-modifier connector on controller, depth-based cooldown state with a brief ready pop, and printed keyboard prompts, and an independent target marker. Training defaults to a compact behavior/shortcut readout that expands on pause. Percentages share the existing damage tiers; identity and target accents remain functional. No 3D arena, gameplay, transport, creator/Ability Lab, or website redesign; connected-room acceptance remains unverified.
keyCharacteristics: Underground fight-club energy with DIY internet-game construction.
Chunky low-poly silhouettes and curated asset-pack collage, harmonized through scale, lighting, material response, palette/value hierarchy, and composition rather than a universal shader.
Archivo Black target name mark and display voice; readable utility typography.
Recognizable character forms and gameplay-readable silhouettes.
Dry self-aware copy that never obscures status.

rules.name: The Ground Anchor Rule
rules.body: Keep a small, steady, open-centre floor cue under each fighter; strengthen its outline as the feet lift, and hide it without supporting floor. A soft contact shadow is a functional depth exception, not a default panel treatment.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Action Yellow (#FFCC22) and retained local orange may both exist on a screen, but one accent owns each region.

rules.name: The Hard Edge Rule
rules.body: Use borders, offsets, and layers before blur, glow, or ambient shadow.

rules.name: The Declaration Rule
rules.body: Give each composition one loud phrase. Supporting labels are smaller, quieter, and useful.

rules.name: The Pair-and-Project Rule
rules.body: Keep all eight semantic moves visible, preserve each normal/special relationship, and let current gameplay state select the move names and artwork. Physical controls remain adapters rather than a second move identity.

rules.name: The Target Clearance Rule
rules.body: Keep the locked-target host above the highest projected head, capsule, or enabled body/accessory/weapon mesh edge, with a 10 px logical gap below the host. Keep horizontal alignment on the fighter root and preserve the anchor when overhead damage is hidden.

rules.name: The Solo Beat Rule
rules.body: Let the existing Solo timer own each start beat; fit one crisp stamp clear of player cards, keep its words visible with reduced flashing, and clear the final declaration while play proceeds.

rules.name: The Solo Finish Rule
rules.body: Let the existing Solo result own the ending; pair one completion declaration with the factual outcome and winning portrait/name, show both fighters for shared victory, and retain the two-second Results handoff.

dos: Do establish the grid before adding crooked poster gestures.
Do make focus, selected, disabled, and confirmation states more obvious than texture.
Do keep gameplay HUD texture restrained and information stable.
donts: Don't use rounded cards, glassmorphism, soft ambient shadows, or glossy gradients by default.
Don't rotate dense information or required actions.
Don't use color as the only status indicator.

fighterGroundMarker.shape: Four anti-aliased Paper arcs with dark edging, open centre, soft radial contact shadow, and a short Action Yellow notch for the local fighter; other renderers remain neutral.
fighterGroundMarker.geometry: 0.8904 m visible outer outline diameter on a 1.2 m horizontal quad; floor offset 0.025 m. The outline never expands or rotates.
fighterGroundMarker.projection: Current renderer X/Z projected onto the baked ArenaHeightmap. Hidden without valid floor or when capsule feet are more than 0.1 m below the sampled platform; not a predicted landing point.
fighterGroundMarker.visibility: Grounded outline alpha 0.12; airborne alpha rises smoothly toward 0.95 as capsule-foot height increases from 0.05 to 0.75 m. No pulse or glow.
fighterGroundMarker.shadow: Soft radial shader shadow is a functional ground-depth exception. Normalized shadow radius changes from 0.75 to 0.92 and peak alpha from 0.28 to 0.16 with airborne visibility.
fighterGroundMarker.integration: One shared material per TargetIndicator, destroyed on teardown. Training/Solo includes the local fighter at initial setup and roster rebuild; existing PvP renderer coverage remains. Target-lock and aimed-destination cues remain separate.
fighterGroundMarker.evidence: .impeccable/review/ground-marker-20261013/verification.json and native-final/: nine actual Unity Training captures, all four fighters, ground/air/early-jump/landing/ledge views at 1920×1080 and 1366×768. Zero current shader, C#, or runtime errors.
fighterGroundMarker.limitations: Connected PvP, packaged-player rendering, physical controls, and NPC roster rebuild remain unverified.

hudMoveDeck.shape: Square physical keys: 64×34 Paper normal tabs on 3 px Combat Orange plates over 64×64 Ink special keys on 4 px HUD Special Blue plates, 2 px outlines. Art fills the face; no icon-box frame.
hudMoveDeck.projection: All eight controls stay visible. Grounded names and artwork are fixed through ground/air transitions; active availability, cooldowns and accepted-use feedback follow simulation state. Names appear in a runtime hover label, not permanent fields.
hudMoveDeck.layout: 304 logical-unit deck: four 68-unit columns (37-unit tab, 8-unit gap, 68-unit key) with 8-unit gaps and an 18-unit bottom margin, about 16% of a 1920-wide viewport. Centered by default, shift/scale only for portrait clearance.
hudMoveDeck.bindings: Controller tabs show the effective face button once for both halves; an LB + connector left of the special row shows the effective modifier, with live LB/RB lettering for shoulders. Keyboard tabs show the effective normal binding and each special key carries a tilted binding sticker, including physical number-row digits on AZERTY; the keyboard SPECIALS connector is hidden.
hudMoveDeck.states: Depth is state: ready keys stand on their plate; a key sinks flush while its move runs or cools down, refills from the bottom behind a centred countdown (whole seconds, tenths under 3 s), then pops back with a brief Action Yellow edge. Holding the actual modifier turns special plates and the connector Action Yellow; chat input, binding capture, Settings and pause suppress held feedback. Reduced flashing removes the transitions and the pop's jump while keeping sunk state.
hudMoveDeck.artwork: Grounded art uses one locked linocut set: limb, weapon or projectile plus effect, Ink/Paper plus the fighter accent, tab icons filled solid for 30 px. Template, references and cleanup live in Assets/Resources/UI/AbilityCards/README.md and tools/hud_icon_prep.py. All four fighters are installed. Each sprite embeds its exact prompt; imported maximum texture size is 256. Airborne sprites and original icons remain.
hudMoveDeck.evidence: .impeccable/review/paired-hud-20261013/mini-verification.json and mini-fixed/. Native grounded/airborne legend stability, remaps, cooldown/READY, runtime hover and viewport checks; controlled specimens are labelled. The move keys were accepted in game on 2026-10-17 without a recorded capture.
hudMoveDeck.nativeGateException: The HTML plate-reference scan cannot resolve Resources.LoadAll<Sprite>; .impeccable/build/state.json remains hero/open. Native evidence is recorded separately; no web tool pass is claimed.

targetLockIndicator.platform: Unity desktop UI Toolkit screen-space presentation
targetLockIndicator.shape: Flat square HUD Ink tag with bold utility damage number and smaller percent unit above the unchanged red brackets/pointer; no heavy border or text outline.
targetLockIndicator.numberRule: Use hud-target-number, switching to hud-target-number-wide at 1000 and above. The hud-target-percent unit has a 2 px left gap and sits 3 logical pixels lower. Both labels share HUDManager.DamageColor and the existing white/orange/red thresholds.
targetLockIndicator.anchor: Cache head and renderer references on target change. Choose the highest valid screen projection of head plus 0.2 m, capsule top, and eight bounds corners of enabled active MeshRenderer/SkinnedMeshRenderer body, accessory, and weapon geometry. Exclude particle and line/trail renderers. Keep horizontal alignment on the fighter root and place the host bottom 10 logical pixels above the projection using actual panel conversion.
targetLockIndicator.states: Hiding overhead damage removes only the readout while retaining host bounds and anchor. Existing opacity and UI-scale settings remain. Behind-camera targets hide and recover when projection is valid; missing head/mesh data falls back to the capsule. Clear/unlock hides the host, and initial 65535% values populate correctly.
targetLockIndicator.evidence: .impeccable/review/target-ui-20261013/verification.json and source-and-captures.json: matching current sources, 15 actual Training captures in review-fix/, all four fighters, idle/hit/airborne poses, Shared values 0/40/90/97/100/107%, both native viewports, UI100/UI140, opacity20/100, and hidden damage. Minimum recorded visible-geometry clearance is 9.346191 logical pixels. Zero native compile/runtime errors.
targetLockIndicator.review: Final scored fix disposition: ship. The bounded Bonk helmet/raised-club clearance finding is resolved at UI100, UI140, and with damage hidden; other roster clearances are retained. This records the scoped fix review.
targetLockIndicator.restoration: Clean stopped Frontend, free settled lease, overhead damage OFF, UI100, target opacity100.
targetLockIndicator.limitations: Connected PvP, packaged-player rendering, and physical controls remain untested. Native C#/UI Toolkit geometry creates no new raster or provenance assets.

soloCountdown.reducedFlashing: Suppress transient scale, slide, and fade while retaining responsive fit, static authored tilt, lettering, and every beat.
soloCountdown.pause: Freeze visible age with the existing Solo admission timer.

Live parent geometry fits and shifts the poster right to clear cards, reserving entrance scale and tilted corners. Poster −3°, slip +4°; no picking or arena veil.

soloEnding.lifetime: Clear any start stamp; clear the end view at age 2s. Existing WaitForSecondsRealtime(2f) Results coroutine is unchanged; observed handoff ~2.35s includes frontend settling.

audio.verification: Native playback and routing observed; physical output not auditioned.

soloEnding.evidence: .impeccable/review/solo-end-20261014/verification.json, source-and-captures.json and review-fix/: all six shipping source hashes and 17 capture hashes match. Fifteen labelled Training UI fixtures cover win/CPU/shared, both native resolutions, UI100/UI140, reduced flashing, all four portraits and longest shared names. Two actual Solo captures from ordinary movement through three natural falls show Shared CPU victory and settled Results.
